sections.p: The form collects the information you enter: name, phone, email, dates, number of people, vehicle type and message.
This information is used only to prepare your availability request and to let the camping reply to you.
This site does not store your data on a server. Your request is prepared in your email or WhatsApp app, which you send yourself.
You may request access, correction or deletion of your information by contacting the camping.
For any question about your data, use the site's contact page.
